column1: # N4 field-to-entity table: every member of NetworkCarryState (include/app/NetworkRunContext.hpp) at nom/wave3 4816d1d.
# Generated by the survey of scripts/nom3_designs/N4_design.md section 2. entity, scope and persistence are the proposal;
# confidence=verify rows are re-read by the owning sub-step. files_member_access counts files with .field or ->field
# (inflated where another struct shares the name); files_carry_bind counts files with carry.field or cs.field.

# Step N4e2 re-placed ten of the Satellite rows by their key (override): emitted_anchor, emitted_anchor_s and eq34_sat_root ("sat_signal") to SatSignal; last_cb_family_partner ("<c>|<signal>") to Constellation.channel; bb_event_last ("station\x1fsat") to Los; cg_event_last (station name) to Station; eq34_epoch_bridged (the per-epoch twin of eq34_epoch_declared), pc_trace_rows and amb_if_rows (trace rows drained each epoch) to N5a; ddfold_degen_prev (a DD block label "grp:u-v") to N4g run.labels.

# Step N4f1 (the step column read N4f) re-placed four of the Arc rows whose old key keeps a string no ArcId reproduces (O4) onto the owner of its typed prefix (override): amb_flag_ep ((station, ambiguity key)), adm_arc ((station, "<sat>|<band>")) and adm_event_last ("event|station|sat|band", the station by name) to Station; relevel_pend ((station, sat, "sig1_sig2")) to Los.

# Step N4g re-placed three telemetry rows by their readers (override): wh_era_len and wh_last_loop_ep (the withhold era's length and freshness: era_live drives wh_escalated, a RAIM decision) and snap_path (a run constant that gates the warm resume and the writer) stay in NetworkCarryState as run state; the other 82 telemetry rows moved to NetworkServiceCounters (D6). It added bb (the Block-Baarda run accumulator, a NetworkCarryState member the survey's parser missed: run.state ColdStart).

# Decision D9 (step N4g): iono_carry (LosState::iono) and gl_hold_iono stay declared. The code proves both empty on every run (the only writer of each is the other, and both start empty), but deleting them retires the carry sites iono_coupling and hold_iono_coupling, rows of the run-end site table and the manifest param_sites record: an output move, left to a step that may move output.
